question: What residual moisture did the NMP- and the water-processed NMC532 cathodes contain at 20 °C?
rendered:
The document "Perspectives on the relationship between materials chemistry and roll-to-roll electrode manufacturing for high-energy lithium-ion batteries" answers the question. 

According to the document, the residual moisture in the NMP-processed NMC 532 cathode was 200 ppm at 20 °C, and the residual moisture in the water-based one was 625 ppm at 20 °C.
